artists.artistName: Cash Savage and the Last Drinks
artists.bio: Cash Savage & The Last Drinks are a Melbourne rock band renowned for intense, emotionally charged performances and the commanding presence of singer, guitarist and songwriter Cash Savage. Formed in the late 2000s, the group blends post-punk, blues, folk and raw rock’n’roll into music that can move from brooding restraint to full-scale catharsis. Their albums include *Wolf*, *The Hypnotiser*, *One of Us*, *Good Citizens* and 2023’s acclaimed *So This Is Love*, a deeply personal exploration of love, loss and change. With guitars, violin, keyboards, percussion and Savage’s unmistakable voice, the band has built a formidable live reputation in Australia and Europe. A fixture of Melbourne’s independent music community, they continue to write and perform new material.
